findings.issue: `Finset.sum_sum_erase_const`/`sum_sum_erase_const'` are off-diagonal double sums `∑ j ∈ s, ∑ k ∈ s.erase j`, whose upstream home is `TauCeti.Algebra.BigOperators.Finset.OffDiagonal` (same `Finset` namespace, same `sum_sum_erase` naming family). Instead they go into a new `BigOperators/Finset.lean` whose docstring claims to extend `Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Ring.Finset` — a module about distributing sums over products, not `erase` double sums, and whose mirror path would be `BigOperators/Ring/Finset.lean` anyway.
